battle.name: 秦蒙恬攻匈奴之戰
battle.brief: 公元前215年（秦始皇三十二年），蒙恬率三十萬眾北擊匈奴，略取河南地，即今內蒙古河套；次年取高闕，築亭障，連秦趙燕舊長城。卡面的亞述長弓屬兩河流域角木之弓，與本役相隔四百八十餘年，並不在河套戰場；交手的弓弩是秦軍蹶張弩與匈奴短角複合弓，後者與亞述弓同出一源。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 秦蒙恬攻匈奴之戰是秦朝在統一之後第一次成規模的對外野戰，時間在秦始皇三十二年，即公元前215年，交戰的兩方是關中的秦帝國與活動於蒙古高原南緣的匈奴聯盟。匈奴並非單一部族，而是由多個遊牧部落鬆散結合而成的聯盟，單于居中號令，各部自有首領，按季候驅趕牲畜往來於漠北與漠南；當時的單于是頭曼單于，其統治範圍西起河西走廊東端，東抵遼東，西北與月氏、羌等部族犬牙交錯。秦朝一方是標準的中央集權軍制：兵源由全國郡縣按戶籍與兵役制徵發的故秦民與新降之地的民眾組成，編為步兵方陣、車兵方陣、弩兵方陣與騎兵方隊，出兵時由將軍統一號令，將軍之下設校尉、屯長、什長層級，並有御史與軍吏隨軍監臨，軍械糧秣由中央與沿途郡縣供應。此役的實際戰場在黃河河套一段所圍出的河南地，即今內蒙古中部的河套平原與陰山南麓；秦軍由上郡、九原一線出動，匈奴則把游騎佈置在陰山各山口與套內草場，兩軍在縱深不足百里的走廊內反覆爭奪。北方草原上的對手也並非只有匈奴：樓煩等部族同樣分佈在河套與晉北山區，秦軍北進時也順帶清剿這些部眾，使此役同時帶有邊疆整頓的性質。
countriesEn: The campaign of Meng Tian against the Xiongnu was the first large-scale external war fought by the Qin state after the unification, in the thirty-second year of the First Emperor, that is 215 BC, and the two sides were the Qin empire centred on the Guanzhong plain and the Xiongnu confederation of the southern fringe of the Mongolian plateau. The Xiongnu were not a single tribe but a loose league of nomadic groups, with the chanyu holding the centre and giving the orders, each part keeping its own leaders and driving its herds between the northern and the southern steppe with the seasons; the chanyu at the time was Touman, and his sphere ran from the eastern end of the Hexi corridor in the west to Liaodong in the east, interlocking with the Yuezhi and the Qiang on the north-west. The Qin side followed a fully centralised military system: the soldiers came from the registers and the service levies of the commanderies and kingdoms of the whole empire, old Qin subjects together with the populations of the newly submitted territories, and they were organised into infantry formations, chariot formations, crossbow formations and cavalry units. A general gave the single order, with xiaowei, tunzhang and shizhang below him, and military inspectors and clerks attended the army to watch it; the weapons and the grain were supplied by the capital and by the commanderies along the line of march. The real battlefield was the Henan ground in the 'H' bend of the Yellow River, that is the Hetao plain and the southern foot of the Yin mountains in what is now central Inner Mongolia. The Qin marched out from the line of Shangjun and Jiuyuan, while the Xiongnu spread their mounted patrols over the passes of the Yin mountains and the pastures inside the loop, the two armies contesting a corridor less than a hundred li deep. The opponent in the northern steppe was not the Xiongnu alone: groups such as the Loufan occupied the Hetao and the mountains of northern Shanxi, and the Qin's advance swept up these populations as well, which gave the campaign the character of a frontier pacification alongside the war of manoeuvre.
people: 決定這一戰的是秦始皇嬴政。他剛剛在十年之內滅掉六國，把天下收進郡縣體制，北方邊患便立刻成為新王朝最迫切的問題：匈奴單于頭曼所部控弦之士以百萬計，長期在河南地牧養牲畜，秦的邊郡與新置的九原、上郡直接暴露在騎兵的打擊範圍之內。統兵的是蒙恬，與弟弟蒙毅同出蒙氏，祖父蒙武亦曾為秦將；蒙恬以果決著稱，臨事敢於自任，秦始皇用兵北疆與北方工程都倚之為重。蒙恬出兵的建言見於《史記·蒙恬列傳》，他指出守塞不如據塞，匈奴之眾來去如風，若只築牆固守便疲於奔命；秦始皇從其議，遂以三十萬眾北擊，取河南地。皇帝同時把最不放心的兩個皇子放在北邊：長子扶蘇以監軍身分在上郡佐蒙恬軍，幼子胡以年幼居秦都。直接指揮前線的還有蒙恬手下的將校與各郡郡守，亭障、烽燧與輸粟的隊伍都由郡縣一級的地方官籌措，這種以郡縣供軍的體制既是秦軍的長處，也是遠征最易被拖垮的地方。匈奴那邊並非沒有能人，頭曼單于之下，諸部首領各領騎隊自牧，太子冒頓年紀尚輕但已以驍銳聞名，他日後弒父自立、於公元前209年成為單于；那一年的秦朝已因陳勝吳廣的起義而大亂，匈奴也趁勢盡取河南地。蒙恬兄弟的結局更見於《史記·蒙恬列傳》末段：秦始皇崩後，胡亥、趙高、李斯合謀，遣使以賜死之名逼蒙恬、蒙毅赴死，蒙恬自度罪當死，服毒自裁，三十萬北疆大軍遂無主。
peopleEn: The decision to fight was the First Emperor's own, Ying Zheng. In the ten years after destroying the six states and folding the realm into the commandery-and-kingdom system, the northern frontier became the most urgent problem of the new dynasty: the chanyu Touman's people, numbering hundreds of thousands of bowmen, had long grazed their herds in the Henan ground, and the Qin border commanderies and the newly created Jiuyuan and Shangjun lay directly within reach of mounted raids. The army was commanded by Meng Tian, who with his younger brother Meng Yi came of the Meng clan, their grandfather Meng Wu having also served as a Qin general. Meng Tian was known for decisiveness and was willing to take responsibility himself, and the emperor leaned on him both for the war in the north and for the great works there. His proposal for the campaign is preserved in the liezhuan of Meng Tian in the Shiji, where he argues that holding a barrier is not the same as securing one, that the Xiongnu host comes and goes like the wind, and that a wall held passively exhausts the troops in pursuit; the emperor took his counsel and sent three hundred thousand men north to take the Henan ground. At the same time the emperor placed in the north the two sons he was least easy about: the elder, Fusu, served as inspector at Shangjun to assist Meng Tian's army, while the younger, Hu, was still a boy in the capital. On the spot, orders were carried out by Meng Tian's officers and by the governors of the commanderies, who provisioned the barriers, the beacon towers and the grain convoys; the system of supporting an army from the commanderies was at once the strength of the Qin force and the point at which a distant expedition was most easily worn down. The Xiongnu side was not without capable men either: under Touman each part leader commanded his own band of riders out of the pastures, and the crown prince Modu, still young, was already famed for his ferocity; he would kill his father and take the title of chanyu in 209 BC, by which time the Qin had been thrown into confusion by the rising of Chen Sheng and Wu Guang, and the Xiongnu retook the Henan ground. The end of the Meng brothers is recorded in the closing part of the liezhuan of Meng Tian in the Shiji: after the First Emperor died, Hu Hai, Zhao Gao and Li Si joined together and sent an envoy with a command that put Meng Tian and Meng Yi to death; Meng Tian judged that his own guilt was capital, took poison, and the three hundred thousand men of the northern army were left without a commander.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓出自新亞述帝國的軍械序列，是兩河流域鐵器與青銅並用的時代產物，年代比本役早約四百八十年：弓身以木為芯、兩端包角或以角條加固，弦用筋腱或腸衣製成，握把短，箭為木桿配鐵鏃或套裝銅鏃，亞述弓兵或立於車上、或步於陣前射擊，與車兵配合前進。亞述帝國早在公元前六世紀覆亡，本役的河套戰場上不可能出現亞述弓兵或亞述式車陣，卡面兵器只能作為同類技術的參照。真正交手的弓弩分屬兩個技術圈：秦軍以弓為步卒之配角，以弩為主力遠程殺傷手段，弩機可用足蹶張開，機槽可納數矢、臨陣一次連發，陝西秦墓出土的銅弩機與陶製弩機模型可以印證；秦兵又備戈、矛、戟、劍與皮甲、札甲，車兵用雙輪戎車，御者自駕一馬或二馬，步兵、車兵、弩兵、騎兵四種方隊的編制，在秦始皇陵兵馬俑坑的排列中看得清楚。匈奴那邊配的是草原式的短角複合弓，箭鏃以骨、石、銅為主，護身有獸皮甲與柳條一類的盾，近身用鄂爾多斯式青銅短刀與骨柄刀；騎兵裝備的馬具在內蒙古出土的匈奴骨飾馬具與銅馬飾件上留有痕跡。工程與運輸方面，秦軍有牛車、馬車組成的糧秣隊與大批徭夫，築塞、夯土、築亭障、設烽燧所需的木料與夯築器具，才是這場戰爭與長城一詞真正相關的部分。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card comes from the arsenal of the Neo-Assyrian state, a product of the Mesopotamian age in which iron and bronze were used side by side, and it is about four hundred and eighty years older than this campaign: the body is a wooden core strengthened with horn at the two tips, the string is made of sinew or gut, the grip is short, and the arrows are wooden shafts with iron heads or socketed bronze heads; the Assyrian archers shot from the chariot or on foot in front of the line and advanced in concert with the chariots. The Assyrian empire had been destroyed more than four centuries before, so neither Assyrian archers nor an Assyrian chariot array can have stood on the battlefield at Hetao, and the weapon on the card can only serve as a comparison with a related craft. The bows that actually met on this ground belonged to two different technical circles. The Qin used the bow as a secondary arm of the infantry and the crossbow as the principal tool of ranged killing: the crossbow was cocked with the feet, its mechanism could hold several bolts and loose them in a single action, and the bronze crossbow triggers and the pottery trigger models excavated from Qin tombs in Shaanxi bear this out. The Qin also carried ge, spear, ji and sword, with leather and lamellar armour, and their chariots were two-wheeled war wagons driven by a charioteer with one or two horses; the organisation of the army into chariot, infantry, crossbow and cavalry formations is plainly visible in the arrangement of the terracotta army pits of the First Emperor's mausoleum. The Xiongnu were equipped with the short composite bow of the steppe, with arrowheads of bone, stone and bronze, body protection of hides and of shields of the willow-branch kind, and at close quarters the Ordos-style bronze short sword and bone-handled knives; the harness of their cavalry survives in the bone horse ornaments and copper fittings excavated from Xiongnu sites in Inner Mongolia. On the engineering and transport side the Qin relied on ox and horse carts for the grain and on a great labour force, and the timber and the ramming equipment needed to build the barrier, raise the towers and set up the beacon fires are the part of this war that is genuinely connected with the phrase Great Wall.
tactics: 秦軍的整套打法可以分成三段。第一段是進攻：蒙恬不把三十萬人一次壓上，而是以車兵與弩兵為前鋒，結成長寬相稱的方陣，沿陰山南麓與黃河南岸的平坦地帶緩緩推進；弩兵在陣前分排齊射，以長程矢壓制匈奴騎兵的衝鋒距離，車兵在兩翼與陣前橫列，用矛戈構成拒馬般的阻滯帶，步卒緊隨其後填補陣線空隙，待敵騎散亂時再以騎兵與輕裝步卒繞擊側後。匈奴的應對是避其銳氣而不與秦人硬拼：游騎不戀戰，退往幕北與陰山以北的草場，等秦軍的隊形被拉長、糧隊與亭障線拉開之後，再以小股騎兵襲擾糧道與烽燧，消耗秦軍的糧秣與體力。第二段是追逐與封鎖：秦軍北逐至塞外，占領南山、陰山各山口與主要渡口，斷絕匈奴南下的通道。第三段最漫長也最關鍵：把運動戰轉成固定邊防，築垣連結秦、趙、燕的舊塞，設亭障、置烽燧、佈縣城、屯戍卒，使塞從來時的臨時營壘變成長城線上可以互相接力的守禦體系。秦軍的難處全在轉輸：從關中把糧食運到河套要沿渭水、河水北運，車馬眾多而道路未修，人畜的消耗常常大過作戰本身，所以蒙恬一面用兵一面修直道，修直道既是交通線，也是軍隊駐紮與補給的倚託。停戰之後雙方都沒有忘記對方的騎兵：秦廷嚴禁將士擅自出塞追北，秦以塞壁與弩陣壓縮匈奴騎兵的活動空間，匈奴則在更北的草場上重新集結，兩種軍事習慣在陰山一線長期對峙。
tacticsEn: The whole Qin method can be divided into three stages. The first is the advance: Meng Tian did not throw all three hundred thousand men forward at once, but made the chariot and crossbow troops the spearhead, drawing them up in formations of matched length and breadth and pushing them slowly along the southern foot of the Yin mountains and the flat ground on the south bank of the Yellow River. The crossbowmen shot in ranked volleys from the front of the line, using their long-range bolts to hold the Xiongnu horsemen at a distance they could not charge from, while the chariots were drawn up in line on the flanks and in front, their spears and ge forming a band of obstruction like a cheval de frise; the infantry followed close behind to fill the gaps in the line, and when the enemy horse had scattered, cavalry and light infantry swung round to strike the flank and the rear. The Xiongnu answer was to avoid the sharpened edge of the Qin and not to trade blows in the open: their mounted patrols did not linger in battle but retired north of the Yin mountains to the pastures beyond, and only when the Qin line had been stretched and the grain columns and the line of barriers drawn apart did they fall on the supply road and the beacon towers with small bodies of horse, wearing down the Qin's food and its stamina. The second stage was pursuit and sealing: the Qin drove north beyond the frontier, seized the passes of the Nan mountains and the Yin mountains and the main fords, and cut the road by which the Xiongnu came south. The third stage was the longest and the most decisive: turning a war of movement into a fixed frontier, building walls to link the old barriers of Qin, Zhao and Yan, setting up towers and beacon fires, posting walled towns and garrisoning soldiers, so that the barrier grew from the temporary camp of the campaign into a system of defence along the line in which one post could hand on to the next. The Qin's difficulty lay entirely in transport: to bring grain from the Guanzhong to the Hetao the carts had to be moved north along the Wei and the Yellow river, with enormous numbers of draught animals and roads not yet made good, so that the wastage of men and animals often exceeded the cost of the fighting itself. Meng Tian therefore fought and built at the same time, and the straight road he opened was both a line of communication and the base on which the army quartered and replenished. After the shooting stopped neither side forgot the enemy's horse: the Qin court forbade officers and soldiers from pursuing north beyond the frontier on their own account, holding the Xiongnu horsemen in a narrowed space with the wall and the crossbow line, while the Xiongnu reassembled on the pastures further north, and the two military habits faced each other along the Yin mountains for a long time.
data: 有根據可寫的數字大致如下。兵員方面，《史記·秦始皇本紀》與《史記·蒙恬列傳》都記蒙恬發兵三十萬人北擊胡、略取河南地，三十萬是史籍明載的出動兵額，而非推算之數；此數包含沿途屯戍與輸運所需的人力，真正投入戰鬥的當然只是其中一部分。推進距離上，賈誼《過秦論》評述秦始皇的北方經營，說蒙恬卻匈奴七百餘里，七百餘里指的是把匈奴逼退的縱深距離。工程尺度上，長城西起臨洮、東至遼東，直道則自九原抵甘泉，二千餘里，都是同一部史書留下的量級概念。地理位置上，河南地即今內蒙古中部河套，九原在今包頭西北，高闕在今呼和浩特西北的陰山山口一帶，自九原至秦都咸陽按今里計算約二千里，一支三十萬人的大軍在這樣的距離上作戰，轉輸的負擔可以看出有多重。匈奴方面的兵源，漢代史家概括為控弦之士百餘萬，這是對匈奴全部部落兵源的估計，並非本役投入的兵力；本役留下的戰損數字史無明文，不能編造。兵種編制方面，秦始皇陵兵馬俑坑中出土的車兵、步兵、騎兵、弩兵四種方陣，是秦軍兵種齊備最直接的物證。前214年秦廷在取得高闕後設亭障、連舊塞，次年又開直道，前後不足三年，工程的密度本身就說明投入的規模。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. On strength, both the annals (benji) of the First Emperor and the liezhuan of Meng Tian in the Shiji record that Meng Tian sent three hundred thousand men north against the Hu and took the Henan ground; the three hundred thousand is an openly recorded figure for the force mustered, not a computed one. That number includes the men needed for the garrisons and the transport along the way, so only part of it was actually engaged. On the distance driven back, Jia Yi's Gu Qin Lun, in its survey of the First Emperor's northern policy, says that Meng Tian pushed the Xiongnu back more than seven hundred li; the seven hundred li is the depth of the withdrawal. On the scale of the works, the Great Wall ran from Lintao in the west to Liaodong in the east, and the straight road ran from Jiuyuan to Ganquan, a little over two thousand li; both are the order-of-magnitude figures left by the same book. On geography, the Henan ground is the Hetao of central Inner Mongolia, Jiuyuan lies north-west of Baotou, and Gaque lies in the passes of the Yin mountains north-west of Hohhot; from Jiuyuan to the Qin capital of Xianyang is about two thousand li by the measure of the present day, and the burden of transport for an army of three hundred thousand operating at that distance tells plainly how heavy it was. On the Xiongnu side, the Han historians summarise the available manpower as more than a million bowmen; that is an estimate of the military capacity of all the Xiongnu parts and is not the force committed in this campaign, and the battle losses of this campaign are not recorded at all and cannot be invented. On the organisation of the Qin army, the four formations of chariots, infantry, cavalry and crossbowmen excavated from the terracotta army pits of the First Emperor's mausoleum are the most direct material evidence that the fighting arms were complete. In 214 BC, after taking Gaque, the court set up towers and beacon fires and joined the old barriers together, and the year after that the straight road was opened; less than three years separate these works, and the density of the building alone shows the scale of what was committed.
cause: 打這場仗的起因，是秦朝在統一之後立刻面對的北方壓力。匈奴聯盟在頭曼單于時期已經佔據河南地，控制從陰山各山口到黃河南岸的草場與水源，兵鋒一推即可抵達秦的邊郡；秦王政在滅齊、統一度量衡與文字、整頓天下之後，把國力轉向北疆，一半是因為匈奴長期南下擾邊，邊郡不得安耕，二來是因為六國之地剛剛歸附，秦廷需要一段沒有內部牽制的時間來鞏固北方邊界。內部的推動者主要是蒙恬。他此前在西北戍邊多年，深知守塞只是把戰線固定在原地，若能主動出塞取河南地，便可以把秦的邊界推到陰山之北，讓遊牧者的牧地與秦的農地之間多出一段緩衝；他向皇帝提出的方案，是進攻與工程並行：先以大軍驅走匈奴，再以長城與郡縣把新取得的土地釘住。皇帝還有另一層考慮：直道與長城都需要在匈奴還在河套活動的時候動工，否則施工線本身就會遭到騎兵的打斷。外部的小因素同樣存在：匈奴內部各部之間並不團結，頭曼單于的號令在漠北並非人人服從，分化與收買的空間一直存在，秦廷利用的正是這一點。而秦軍在編制上的確具備執行這樣計畫的條件：三十年來各郡縣的徵兵、屯田與兵器生產，已經把足夠的人力與物資集中到關中、河東與巴蜀，只是這一次出征的規模超過了此前任何一次國內用兵。
causeEn: The reason for this war was the northern pressure that the Qin court met the moment the unification was done. Under the chanyu Touman the Xiongnu league had already taken the Henan ground, controlling the pastures and the water from the passes of the Yin mountains down to the south bank of the Yellow River, so that a single push of their horse would reach the Qin border commanderies. After destroying Qi, unifying the weights, the measures and the script, and setting the whole realm in order, King Zheng turned the resources of the state northward: partly because the Xiongnu had harried the border for years and the border commanderies could not farm in peace, and partly because the lands of the six states had only just been brought in and the court needed a stretch of time free of internal entanglement in which to consolidate the northern frontier. The driving force inside the court was chiefly Meng Tian. He had spent years on guard in the north-west and knew well that holding a barrier only fixes the front in one place; if the Henan ground could be taken by striking out beyond the frontier, the Qin border could be pushed north of the Yin mountains, opening a buffer between the pastures of the herders and the fields of the Qin. The plan he put to the emperor ran attack and works together: first drive the Xiongnu away with a great army, then nail the newly taken land down with a wall and with commanderies and counties. The emperor had a further consideration: the straight road and the wall had to be begun while the Xiongnu were still in the Hetao, otherwise the line of construction itself would be cut by horsemen. Smaller external factors mattered as well: the Xiongnu parts were not united among themselves, the orders of Touman were not obeyed by every leader in the northern steppe, and there was always room for the court to divide them and to buy them over, which is precisely what the Qin used. And the Qin army did have the organisation to carry out such a plan: thirty years of levies, of farming garrisons and of weapons production in the commanderies had gathered enough men and materials at Guanzhong, in Hedong and in Bashu; only this campaign was larger than any earlier employment of troops inside the empire.
impact: 這一戰的直接後果是北疆格局的改變。河南地落入秦的版圖，秦廷在河套設置郡縣、移民實邊，把中原的農耕、鐵器和車輛第一次穩定地推到陰山腳下；匈奴失去河套的牧場與基地，頭曼單于退居漠北，秦與匈奴之間從此多出一條由長城與亭障構成的固定界線。這條界線在此後兩千年裡都是東亞北方的基本邊界：漢承秦制，漢武帝時再取河南地、置朔方郡與五原郡，修復並延伸秦塞，直到河西的兩漢疆域成形。制度上的傳承同樣重要，邊郡、屯田、馬政、烽燧與障塞的體系，秦代確立的規模在漢代被放大沿用，後來史家講到秦人築塞時，講的正是蒙恬這一役確立的辦法。另一面的代價極為沉重：三十萬大軍留駐北疆，連同直道、亭障與郡縣營造所需的徭夫，使秦朝的民力與財政長期緊張；後世史論在稱頌蒙恬卻匈奴七百餘里的同時，也把連年北征與築塞修路列為勞民傷財的例證。公元前210年秦始皇死後北疆軍隊無主，郡縣的戍卒與民夫大批逃亡，陳勝吳廣起義時的隊伍正是北疆防線上的兵力，秦朝在北方投入的三十萬人，反過來成為壓垮王朝的負債之一。蒙恬、蒙毅之死又讓秦廷失去最熟悉北方的一批將領，長城沿線的守備在秦末已形同虛設，匈奴趁中原大亂之際重取河南地，中原與草原的第一次大規模碰撞，要等到漢武帝的時代才重新上演。
impactEn: The direct consequence of this war was a change in the shape of the northern frontier. The Henan ground passed into the Qin map, the court established commanderies and counties in the Hetao and moved people to settle the border, and for the first time the farming, the iron and the carts of the central plains were pushed in a stable manner to the foot of the Yin mountains. The Xiongnu lost the pastures and the base of the Hetao, Touman withdrew to the northern steppe, and between Qin and Xiongnu there now stood a fixed line made of the wall and of the beacon towers. That line remained the basic boundary of northern East Asia for the two thousand years that followed: the Han took over the Qin arrangements, took the Henan ground again in the time of Emperor Wu, founded the commanderies of Shuofang and Wuyuan, and repaired and extended the Qin barriers, until the Han territory in the far west took its shape. The transmission of institutions mattered as much: the system of border commanderies, farming garrisons, horse administration, beacon fires and barrier forts, established on the Qin scale in this period, was enlarged and carried on by the Han, and when later historians spoke of the Qin building the barrier, what they meant was precisely the practice settled in Meng Tian's campaign. The cost on the other side was extremely heavy. The three hundred thousand men left in the north, together with the labourers needed for the straight road, the towers and the building of the commanderies, kept the finances and the strength of the people of Qin taut for a long time, and the historians who praised Meng Tian for driving the Xiongnu back more than seven hundred li counted the years of northern campaigning and the building of walls and roads among their examples of labour spent in vain. When the First Emperor died in 210 BC the northern army was left without a commander, garrison soldiers and labourers fled from the commanderies in great numbers, and the companies that rose in the revolt of Chen Sheng and Wu Guang were in fact the troops of the northern defensive line, so that the three hundred thousand men Qin had put into the north turned in the end into one of the debts that weighed down the dynasty. The deaths of Meng Tian and Meng Yi also cost the court the batch of generals who knew the north best; the defence along the wall had become a formality by the end of Qin, the Xiongnu took the Henan ground again in the disorder of the central plains, and the first great collision between the plain and the steppe after this one had to wait for the age of Emperor Wu.
result: 就公元前215年這一場而言，結果是明確的：秦軍以三十萬眾北出，逐匈奴而取河南地，秦的邊界推到陰山南麓，頭曼單于部眾北撤，爭取到一段沒有正面會戰的僵持。次年即前214年，秦廷再取高闕，築亭障，連結秦、趙、燕的舊塞，形成西起臨洮、東至遼東的長城線；再一年開直道，自九原抵甘泉，把關中與北疆用一條可調兵、可運糧的大道連起來。從純粹的軍事結果看，秦軍是勝方：對手退卻，土地到手，工程體系落地，而且從此把北疆的守勢轉為掌握主動。代價同樣清楚：三十萬大軍與大批徭夫常年駐守北方，秦廷的財政與民力被拉成一根繃緊的弦，耕作與徵發的失衡埋下日後的危機；當公元前210年秦始皇死於沙丘，繼位的胡亥與趙高、李斯用一道偽造的詔書賜死蒙恬、蒙毅，被留在北疆的秦軍隨即失去指揮，無力阻止匈奴重入河南地。真正意義上的結局要晚得多：秦的長城與郡縣制被漢朝全部承接，漢武帝元狩二年即前127年遣衛青收復河南地、置朔方郡與五原郡，把蒙恬一役的成果重新拿到手；匈奴則在漢的持續打壓下退向漠北，那道陰山線下的界線又穩固地存在了數百年。一場三十萬人參與的邊疆戰役，留下的不是一場會戰的勝負，而是一條北亞草原與中原農耕之間延續兩千年的分界。
resultEn: For the year 215 BC itself the outcome is clear: the Qin marched out with three hundred thousand men, drove the Xiongnu off and took the Henan ground, the Qin border was pushed to the southern foot of the Yin mountains, Touman's people withdrew north, and a period of standoff without a set-piece battle was bought. The following year, 214 BC, the court took Gaque, raised the beacon towers and linked the old barriers of Qin, Zhao and Yan together, forming the line of the wall from Lintao in the west to Liaodong in the east; the year after that the straight road was opened from Jiuyuan to Ganquan, joining the Guanzhong and the northern frontier by a great road along which troops could be moved and grain could be carried. On the military result alone the Qin were the winners: the enemy withdrew, the land was taken, the system of works was built, and the defensive posture on the northern frontier was turned into control of the initiative. The cost is just as clear: three hundred thousand men and a great many labourers stayed in the north year after year, the finances and the strength of the people of Qin were drawn into a taut cord, and the imbalance between farming and conscription laid the seeds of the crisis to come. When the First Emperor died at Shaqiu in 210 BC, the successor Hu Hai together with Zhao Gao and Li Si put Meng Tian and Meng Yi to death with a forged command, and the Qin army left in the north lost its commander at once and was unable to keep the Xiongnu out of the Henan ground. The true conclusion came much later: the Han took over the wall and the commandery system of Qin entire, and in the second year of Yuanshou, 127 BC, sent Wei Qing to recover the Henan ground and to establish the commanderies of Shuofang and Wuyuan, taking up again the results of Meng Tian's campaign; the Xiongnu, pressed continuously by the Han, withdrew to the northern steppe, and the line below the Yin mountains stood firm for several hundred years more. A frontier war in which three hundred thousand men took part left behind not the result of a single battle but a boundary between the steppe of northern Asia and the farming of the central plains that was to run for two thousand years.
